Evergreen trees can be chopped down to provide logs and 25 Woodcutting experience.

Buckets of sap can be acquired by using a knife on an evergreen tree while having a bucket in your inventory. This is required for The Eyes of Glouphrie and Icthlarin's Little Helper quests.

Tree locations

[edit | edit source]

Evergreen trees can be found in the following locations:

  • Ice Mountain
  • White Wolf Mountain
  • Burthorpe
  • North of Barbarian Outpost
  • Piscatoris Hunter area
  • Dragontooth Island
  • Frozen Waste Plateau
  • North of Falador
  • East of Sinclair Mansion
  • Wyrmscraig

Mechanics

[edit | edit source]

Evergreen trees have the same mechanics as regular trees, giving logs and always depleting after one section cut. The tree respawns between 36–60 seconds, randomly, and is not influenced by world population.[1] The chance to successfully chop is affected by the axe used and Woodcutting level, better axes and a higher woodcutting level increases the likelihood of successfully receiving a log. Kandarin headgear 1 and above gives double logs when cutting them.

Additional Drops

[edit | edit source]
  • Beaver – Evergreen trees have a chance to drop the beaver Woodcutting pet. At level 1 Woodcutting there is a 1 in 317,622 chance to receive the beaver and a 1 in 315,172 chance at level 99.
  • Clue nest – Evergreen trees have a chance of dropping any tier of clue nest, based on Woodcutting level, the tree's base chance, and access to the reward tiers of Combat Achievements. See Clue nest § Woodcutting rates for a detailed breakdown.
